[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Large-catalog bench harness and recorded baselines[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]

    [#D7D7AF]for the Updates > Plugins sub-tab, record p50/p95/max baselines at [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]later phases have a measuring stick.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Latest-version enrichment that scales with installed count, [/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]not catalog size[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]enrich[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bench[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]enrich: remove the quadratic installed-version lookup, scope eager PyPI [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]enrichment to installed entries, add a lazy per-entry latest fetch for [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]search cap are still returned, surface truncation and incomplete_results[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]as catalog warnings, and make the gh timeout scale with page count [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]instead of a flat 20 s.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Constant-time render, filter, and navigation paths[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]incoming-commit caches.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
